summary: 'Authentication failed' means credentials didn't work; paramiko may be using SSH keys and ignoring your password, so disable key lookup with ANSIBLE_PARAMIKO_LOOK_FOR_KEYS=False or look_for_keys = False.
questions: Why does Ansible ignore my network device password?
How do I stop paramiko from trying SSH keys?
How do I fix Authentication failed for a Cisco device?

answer_card.title: Fix 'Authentication failed'
answer_card.answer_md:
If you pass a password (via `password:`, `provider:` or `ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD`), paramiko may be trying SSH keys instead. Disable key lookup:
```shell
export ANSIBLE_PARAMIKO_LOOK_FOR_KEYS=False
```
Permanently in `ansible.cfg`:
```ini
[paramiko_connection]
look_for_keys = False
```
